risks.risk: PS4 model/version is unknown (could be original/Pro/Slim), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the console’s underside/side sticker showing CUH model number (e.g., CUH-10xx/CUH-20xx/CUH-70xx).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value PS4 variant (worst case) until the CUH model is shown.

risks.risk: Functionality not confirmed (disc drive, HDMI output, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, controllers charging).
risks.proof: A short video showing the console powering on to the home screen, controller pairing, and launching one installed game (or showing the game library).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified/assume issues are possible (worst case) until it boots and plays.

risks.risk: Installed games claim may be incorrect or tied to an account (license/restore issues).
risks.proof: Photo/video of the PS4 'Library' showing the installed games list, plus confirmation whether it’s offline discs or account-based downloads.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controllers only (no guaranteed games) until the installed list is shown.

risks.risk: Controller condition unknown (stick drift, broken buttons, worn analogs).
risks.proof: Video showing analog movement calibration test (or a game moment demonstrating no drift) and a close-up of both controllers’ sticks/buttons.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controllers may need repair/replacement (worst case) until stick/button health is demonstrated.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the PS4 model sticker (CUH-xxxx) on the console (photo of underside/side).
Video: power on to PS4 home screen + controller pairing/working.
Photo/video of the PS4 Library showing the installed games (the exact 5).
Video or screen test showing controller analogs/buttons respond correctly (no drift).
response.reason: From photo 0, it’s clearly a PS4 console with controllers, but the exact PS4 model and the '5 games installed' claim are not verifiable remotely. Without the CUH model and a visible game library, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
